name: web-mini-games
description: A browser mini-game arcade built with Next.js.

scripts.dev:dinner: npm run build:dinner && wrangler d1 migrations apply mini-hub-dinner --local --config standalone/order-dinner/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler dev --config standalone/order-dinner/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:arcade: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:lemonade: npm run build:lemonade && wrangler deploy --config standalone/lemonade-stand/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:dinner: npm run build:dinner && wrangler d1 migrations apply mini-hub-dinner --remote --config standalone/order-dinner/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config standalone/order-dinner/wrangler.jsonc
